findings.head: {"errors.json.text.0": "Length must be between 1 and 140."}
findings.label: intended
findings.why: Announced in the PR description: "New posts and edits can be at most 140 characters (was 280), to keep the feed short.". The schema validation for the 'text' field was changed from max=280 to max=140, which directly causes the error message to update from 'Length must be between 1 and 280' to 'Length must be between 1 and 140'.

coverage.reach_note: The changed code runs when the app loads (module or class level), so which users reached it can't be measured line by line.
